_source: Each entry is a claim our profile (gdl/designsys/afterburn.json) or its README made that Afterburn's own pages contradict, found by the grammar measurement of 2026-10-22: every page and popup of seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl, 725, 525, 320, 1230W, 1535 and the 300M pair, read with gdl.project (each control's rect, look, caption and font) beside its renders and beside the 1220, 1020, 1520, 520, 535 and 320 Series templates. `template` is what those pages do, off the seed and pages named; the region frame (panels[series].frame) is the same seeds measured by tests/measure_series.py frame_of. `python -m gdl.designsys audit afterburn` checks every resolution against the profile, the README and the frame as they stand.

entries.claim: The README type floor says 'Nothing under 14 pt'.

template.does: 94 of the 1035's template buttons caption at 13 pt (the profile acknowledges this), the labels 'ZOOM', 'CHANNEL' and 'LAST' are 13 pt, and the dialer's letter labels are 10.5 pt. The 725's buttons caption at 10.5 pt (seeds/Afterburn 725.gdl: 368 states), its mode launcher among them - Video Conference (8120), 115x60 at 15,528 - and the 525's at 13 pt (seeds/Afterburn 525.gdl: 192 states).

entries.reason: The 14 pt floor the toolkit checks (gdl.spec MIN_BODY_POINT_SIZE; docs/design-rules.md section 2), which each panel scales - 16 pt on the 725, 18 on the 525 (gdl.designsys.models' `floor`): a caption under it is refused, so the profile lifts the template's 13 pt to 14, and a region page lifts each panel's captions to its floor, growing the control that holds them. The README says the template's own go under it.
entries.here: Nothing is under each panel's type floor, the toolkit's - 14 pt on the 1035, 16 on the 725, 18 on the 525 - where the template's captions go down to 13 pt on the 1035, 10.5 on the 725 and 13 on the 525: a caption there grows its control, the 725's mode launcher 143 wide where the template's is 115.

fix.readme: Nothing under 14 pt: that is the toolkit's floor, and a template's own smallest captions can be under it

entries.claim: The README size rules say 'at least 53 px each way', 'at least 12 px between touchable controls', 'no more than nine buttons in one group' and 'GUI Designer's 10 px nudge'.

entries.reason: The 2 mm gap and the 9 mm touch minimum (53 px on the 1035) the toolkit checks between and on touch targets, and Extron's documented nine-button and 10 px standards (docs/design-rules.md section 2), which a designer's own controls keep. The RightRail grows the 50 px slider to the 53 px minimum (a Rail to 54) and stands Help and Power 12 px apart about their pair's middle, 62 wide; the README now says the template does not always keep them.
entries.here: Controls are at least 53 px each way and 2 mm apart, nine to a group, on the 10 px nudge - Extron's Design Standards; the template's rail buttons are 50 tall and 8 px apart. The slider is drawn 53 wide where the template's is 50, and Help and Power 62 wide and 12 apart where the template's are 64 and 8.

fix.readme: Extron's Design Standards, which its own templates do not always keep
